title: 中国人的夏夜②夜市烧烤：一年三千多亿，一半的夏夜是烤炉给的 | Summer Nights P2 · BBQ 🍢
description:
你家夜市，最爱撸的是哪一串？评论区报菜名。

【中国人的夏夜 第2集 夜市烧烤】2023年淄博烧烤带火全国，中国烧烤市场规模一年超过3224亿元、同比增长27.1%；到2024年上半年，全国已有52.6万家烧烤类餐饮企业。有41.5%的人，就蹲在夜市路边摊上撸串。淄博的"三件套"——小烤炉、小饼、蘸料，撸下一串卷进小饼。这口烟火气，东北话有个最传神的说法："整点串儿"——一个"整"字是万能动词，来点、搞点、弄点全靠它。三五个人，撸串到深夜。所以那52万家店，卖的其实是整个夏夜。

Ep.2 Night-market BBQ. After Zibo went viral in 2023, China's barbecue market topped 322.4 billion yuan in a year, up 27.1%; by mid-2024 there were 526,000 BBQ businesses nationwide, and 41.5% of people eat their skewers right on the street. Zibo's "trio" — a little grill, a flatbread, a dip — you slide a skewer off and roll it into the bread. Up in the Northeast they call it "zheng dian chuan'r": "zheng" is the all-purpose verb for grab-some-of-anything. Three or five friends, skewers till late — those 520,000 shops are really selling the summer night.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food & folk-custom note, no investment advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
